name: bat_ceiling_colony
description: Strip of cave ceiling packed with about 167 hanging Egyptian fruit bats (the 40,000 crowd): uneven rock band #4a3f36 (y 0..~90, black outline) with small simplified upside-down bats (~28x55, grey-brown #6a5a4a, wings folded) in ragged overlapping rows hanging down to y ~300. Anchor top-centre (0,0), 1920x300.
